newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call, no trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call, no trade.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Friday. No barges traded versus none Thursday.
Values were not comparable with Thursday's session.
- One barge, Mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south), next week, bid 117-1/2 percent of tariff - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Mississippi (St Paul-Savage), next week, bid 140 percent, two barges offered 155 percent - no comparison on either value.
- Two barges, Mississippi (Memphis), next week, no bid, offered 90 percent - unchanged from Wednesday offer.
- Two barges, lower Ohio, one each week of August 24 and 31, bid 130 percent, no offer.
- Two barges, mid Mississippi (McGregor and south), one each week of September 21 and 28, bid 210 percent, offered 230 - no comparison on either value.
- Four barges, Mississippi (LaCrosse-Savage), one each week September, bid 182-1/2 percent-no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Mississippi (LaCrosse-Savage) one each week October, bid 265 percent - no comparison, no offer.
